Thanks — draft answers below (short form, for the template rows).

Data flows / purposes:
- We ingest customer-provided prompts and model outputs for the purpose of inference and billing. For hosted customers, transcripts are stored only as required for short-term troubleshooting and billing; customers may opt in to longer retention for analytics.

Lawful basis:
- Contractual necessity and legitimate interests (performance, fraud prevention, analytics). For EU data subjects, processing under contract and standard clauses where applicable; customers retain responsibility for lawful basis for end-user data.

Retention table (summary):
- Short-term logs (inference traces): default 30 days (configurable to 90/180 for enterprise)
- Billing records (aggregates): 2 years
- Audit/security logs: 1 year (retained per SOC 2 controls)

SCCs / transfer mechanisms:
- We support Standard Contractual Clauses for EU transfers and offer dedicated Private deployments for data residency. We also provide contractual SCC addenda as requested.

HIPAA note:
- Redwood offers HIPAA-eligible deployments under an executed BAA (Private/Dedicated); hosted self-serve is not covered. Recommend we include the following sentence in the PIA: "Redwood can enter into a BAA for covered health data processed under Private or Dedicated deployments; hosted plans require a sales/legal engagement to onboard HIPAA workflows."

I'll upload data-flow-diagram.png (redacted) and retention-table.csv to the Drive.

— Rishi
Director, Privacy & Policy
Redwood Inference
